title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. We had intended to purchase a flat about 10 years back and for the same we had given an amount of Rs.160000 (Rupees One Lac Sixty Thousand only) to the builder. Unfortunately, the building never got complete and the builder was not able to return us the money either. Now after 10 years or so, we were able to settle the matter through a shop which the builder gave to us in return of the money. We sold this shop and got back Rs.150000 (Rupees One Lac Fifty Thousand Only). My question is are we obliged to pay Zakat on this amount for the 10 years. If yes, please oblige by giving us the way of calculating the same. 2034 views Q. I have a family house in my town (India). I have purchased another flat in the city for investment purpose 1514 views Q. Zakaat 1499 views Q. Can a poor husband take money of zakah from his wife 5699 views Q. Zakat on Under construction Flat whose Installment is being paid and property is still not registered under my name. 7689 views Q. Zakat on savings to buy a house which is under construction 3271 views Q. Sadqa money used 3015 views Q. My mother-in-law is a widow and she is earning Rs.13,000 every month from her pension, her husband's half pension and also through rent.Whenever she has to pay zakat she will cry that she has to give so much and now she says some one has said to her that as now she is widow now she can ask her sons to pay zakat. Is it correct that her son can pay zakat? As she doesn't spend a single amount on her sons. 5784 views Q. Can we give the Ushr to relatives? 3418 views Q. Is it compulsory to tell a person that the money being given to him is a Sadqah? 1700 views Q. What is the procedure of zakat. 1913 views Q. Assalamualaikum I have a question regarding the zakat on plots. I am from Nanded (Maharashtra). In Nanded, My family owns a house and a plot. I am working in a company in hyderabad so stay in hyderabad in a rented house and pay a rent nearly 4000. We have kept the plot with the following intention. 1. we will sell it when some urgent need arise. 2. We will sell that plot to build a house in hyderabad. So will i have to pay zakat on that plot? 1622 views Q. Payment of Zakat 2246 views Q. Mother has gold jewelleries some of which like bangles, necklace and earrings, she wears routinely 1926 views Q. "I have agricultural land inherited from my father, as my father used to take bribe I am not sure that by which amount he has purchased (More chances of bribe money) , 1. How I can make it halal? 2. Can I take out amount equivalent to price of land when it was purchased and distribute it to poor with niyat of repaying that bad amount, so agricultural income becomes halal to me? 3. If yes I have to pay at rate ?When it was purchased or at present rate?" 1772 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 15600 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum, I thought of giving Rs 1500 to needy people every month from my Salary and Alhamdulillah I was doing the same from one or two years. Now my parents thing that it might be difficult for me to give Zakat amount which may be approx RS 15000 and they are telling me to do Niyat as Zakat for the amount which I am paying every month as Rs 1500, so that in 10 months the Zakat will be paid over. (The amount Rs 1500 is given to one of our relative whose husband is expired and she has a small kid, I am sending it to my parents and they are given it to her) I am staying in rented house for which intially I have given RS 42,000 as a deposit and the rent is Rs 7000. I thought every month I have to pay the rent, after the first month I told to my house owner I want to pay Rs 7000 rent, he said you have already paid RS 42,000 and no need to pay the rent every month, once the amount is over in 6 months, you have to pay for another 6 month Rs 42,000. Now I have the 3 months rent rs 7000 each (i.e., RS 21,000) with me, I wanted to give Zakat from this amount and I wish not to stop Rs 1500 which I am given it to needy every month. If I pay Zakat from this amount, I will not be having Rs 42,000 to pay to my house owner as 6 months rent which I have to pay after 3 months, but I believe Allah will arrange some amount Inshallah. The six months amount Rs 42,000 owner has mentioned in the agreement that I should pay without fail. I have not told about the amount which I have with me (i.e., RS 21,000) to my parents, as if I tell them they will ask for the money as they have lot of debt. They had become debt as they did lavish expenses at the time of my brother marriage (Lavish expenses like purchase of clothes worth Rs 10,000 each and distributing chocolate box and giving grand party etc.) Total they spend approx. Rs.2 Lakhs which they had taken debt, even I said not to do lavish expenses they did not heard me. I am sending amount for expenses to my parents every month. Some month before itself my parents said to stop giving Rs 1500 to needy, as they had debt and first we need to pay our debt. Question: 1. As per above mentioned details, Please let me know do I have to do Niyat as Zakat for the amount which I am paying every month Rs 1500 and stop paying Rs 1500 to needy. (or) 2. Can I pay Zakat from the Rs 21,000 mentioned above and continue paying Rs 1500 every month to needy. 3. Can we give the whole Zakat amount to only one person? 4. Please let me know if you have any other suggestions? They had become debt as they did lavish expenses at the time of my brother marriage (Lavish expenses like purchase of clothes worth Rs 10,000 each and distributing chocolate box and giving grand party etc.) Total they spend approx. Rs.2 Lakhs which they had taken debt, even I said not to do lavish expenses they did not heard me. I am sending amount for expenses to my parents every month. Some month before itself my parents said to stop giving Rs 1500 to needy, as they had debt and first we need to pay our debt. Question: 1. As per above mentioned details, Please let me know do I have to do Niyat as Zakat for the amount which I am paying every month Rs 1500 and stop paying Rs 1500 to needy. (or) 2. Can I pay Zakat from the Rs 21,000 mentioned above and continue paying Rs 1500 every month to needy. 3. Can we give the whole Zakat amount to only one person? 4. Please let me know if you have any other suggestions? Answer ID: 15600 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1463/73=TB=1430) First of all, you should pay the debt of your father. Once you paid off all the debts, help the widows and the poor. If the widow is needy and she does not have wealth equal to nisab, you can give Zakah to her. You should take out 2.5% (as Zakah) of the 21000 which you have. You can give Zakah amount to one individual as well, but the amount should not exceed nisab. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
